tools.name: get_connected_installation
tools.description: Identify the linked CasaCaddy Pro installation and its current maintenance-guide allowance. No device identifier, billing data, on-device home library, appliance list or task history is exposed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_maintenance_guide" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
